purpose: M08: the pilots-ci revision 4 lanes measured twice on the same host, once with every job stating runs_on.isolation: container and once with isolation: microvm, to publish the microVM executor's overhead per lane and condition against the B09 gate. A new contract rather than a change to revision 4, which stays frozen: its records keep their meaning and are never mixed with these.

extends.note: Everything named in `inherited` applies unchanged: host, CCD placement, 10 CPUs and 26 GiB, source commits, image digests, the three conditions and the freshness rules. The reference host must be `kvm-host`, the only host with usable KVM.

isolation.how_stated: bench/p14-pilot.sh prep KIT ROOT PILOT ISOLATION rewrites the committed pipeline copy so every job's runs_on reads `{ labels: [egress], isolation: <condition> }`; commands, caps, caches and images stay as examples/pilots/ has them. The worker is the same binary, host and enrollment shape for both; it states isolation.container and isolation.microvm (worker --check).
isolation.pairing: One ROOT per isolation and lane, the same KIT (same sentinel binary), the same host, the same day. Samples alternate by isolation block, never run concurrently: CPU pressure under 2 % at the start of each sample as in revision 4, and a condition's two series are taken back to back.
isolation.guest_image: The microVM guest is built from the same image digest the container runs; the record's attempt data carry the guest image digest (K07).

gate.metric: p95 of intake_to_finished_ns per lane and condition, non-warmup samples that passed
also_reported: per-phase medians (queue to first process, job start to finish)
gate.on_failure: A lane over the gate is a bug to fix in M04-M06; the default (microVM on a KVM host) is never changed silently and the gate is never raised. Fewer than 10 non-warmup samples per series is reported as development evidence, not a gate result.

b03_remeasure.harness: bench/b03-setup.sh and bench/b03-latency.py with SENTINEL_BENCH_ISOLATION=container|microvm at setup; each record carries `isolation`.
b03_remeasure.budgets: dispatch p95 < 100 ms, warm first process p95 < 2 s, visible logs p95 < 250 ms, indexed failure query p95 < 200 ms, cancel to termination p95 < 2 s, 8 KiB failure view (plan 12).

revision_history.note: first revision: adds the stated isolation to the revision-4 lanes; no sample has been recorded under it yet
